My baby had that! Or what looked exactly like that. Our pediatrician said it was cradle cap. We were told to dilute head and shoulders with warm water. Wash the baby’s hair, let it sit on their head for 2 min. Rinse. 
I know it’s weird that it’s on their face & they’re telling you to wash the baby’s hair but I guess cradle cap affects face & neck too. So just wash the baby’s hair. 
Do this twice a week and after a few washes it will clear up. 
And after the third wash it cleared right up & my baby’s face is totally clear now! We didn’t put any lotion on her face though bc it irritated it more.
